title: Wedding planning marketplace
summary: Plan your wedding and book vendors in one place.
whyItFails: One-time customers. Couples marry once (usually). Vendor fragmentation. Small vendors are hard to onboard. Heavy content competition. Free inspiration everywhere.
whatWouldChange: Vendor software that brings supply onto the platform.

attempts.outcome: Merged with WeddingWire in 2019 under private equity
attempts.notes: Vendors sued in 2025 over fake leads; the company denied referring fake accounts.

reasons.detail: Vendor fragmentation: Small vendors are hard to onboard.
Heavy content competition: Free inspiration everywhere.
